user.title: CozyLife battery sensor
user.description: Enter the fixed IP address of the sensor (reserve it in your router). The sensor sleeps most of the time; if it does not answer now, it is added anyway and identifies itself at its next wake-up.

error.wrong_model: The sensor at this address reports a different model.

init.title: Sensor options
init.description: The sensor wakes up about once per report interval for a few seconds. With the wake window, Home Assistant learns that rhythm and only probes shortly before the expected wake-up.

data.sensor_wake_window: Probe only around the learned wake-up
data.wake_lead_seconds: Start probing before the expected wake-up
data.wake_tail_seconds: Stop probing after the expected wake-up

data_description.sensor_wake_window: Off: probe four times per second all the time, like the original integration. Until two wake-ups have been seen, the integration always probes continuously.
data_description.wake_lead_seconds: Smaller values mean less Wi-Fi traffic but a higher risk of missing the sensor. After a missed or too tight window the next window automatically uses at least 20 s.
data_description.wake_tail_seconds: After a missed or too tight window the next window automatically uses at least 60 s. After three missed windows in a row the integration searches continuously again.
data_description.filter_outliers: Optional four-sample median filter for false readings such as sudden zeros.
data_description.enable_debug: Logs every probe, connection and the timing of each caught wake-up. Logs contain no IP addresses or measured values.
